source_text.ISS-0937:
id: ISS-0937
title: "Backend CI red at UTC month boundary: TenantTemplateTest parity (extra events_y2026m09) and PartitionMaintenance/RetentionOperations/EventRetention tests ({:error,:partition_not_eligible}) fail on 2026-10-01"
discovered_by: ELIXIR-DEV
discovered_in_run: WF03-ISS0930-20261001 (Step Final, PR #2076; filed by ORCH)
discovered_at: "2026-10-01T00:21:56Z"
severity: MAJOR
description: >
  PR #2076 (scripts/fixtures-only, no lib/ or migration change) had its backend job fail twice. Run 1: one TenantTemplateTest
  parity failure extra=["events_y2026m09"]. Re-run after the 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-01 UTC rollover: 12 failures in
  PartitionMaintenanceTest, RetentionOperationsTest, EventRetentionTest ({:error, :partition_not_eligible}). Hypothesis, not
  reproduced on main: the tests depend on the real current UTC month / partition eligibility and break at the month boundary.
  PR #2076 was merged with --admin per decision 0018. Confirm via main's CI on ed40c2fa, then make the tests clock-independent.
affected_files:
  - test/letflow/events/ (partition maintenance / retention tests)
  - test/letflow/tenants/ (tenant template parity test)
queue_ref: Q-920  # queue issue_ref ISS-0920 collides with an existing local file; local filename ISS-0937
github_ref: GH-2077
status: open

task.description: WF-03 Step 3c SECURITY-REVIEWER gate for ISS-0937. The change (git diff origin/main..HEAD, non-handoff files; commit just made by ORCH) touches only test/ support and tests: test/support/partition_clock.ex (new), test/support/tenant_fixture.ex, test/support/tenant_template.ex (check_table_set/2 now ignores dynamic events_yYYYYmMM partition tables on both sides), and three retention tests. No lib/, no migrations. Apply your scope test per docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md: state explicitly whether this touches a tenant-data path (tenant template/clone parity is a tenant-isolation verification harness - assess whether loosening check_table_set/2 could mask a real tenant-schema drift, RLS/ownership/privilege or isolation regression: verify the predicate cannot hide non-partition tables, that the fixed four partition tables and the RLS/owner/index/column parity checks on the fixed tables remain compared, and that dynamic-partition tables' own columns/indexes/RLS parity is still checked wherever the original code checked them, or if not, whether that is a loss of coverage that matters; read tenant_template.ex and its callers yourself). Verdict PASS/FAIL with findings by INV number if any. Modify nothing but this handoff. Set IN_PROGRESS at claim then COMPLETED/FAILED, result.status PASS/FAIL; next_action 'Route to REVIEWER' on PASS.

result.summary: Scope: test-harness only (test/support + tests); no lib/, no migrations, no secrets, no routes/response shaping. It touches a tenant-isolation VERIFICATION harness (TenantTemplate parity), so masking risk assessed. check_table_set/2 predicate ^events(_archive)?_y\d{4}m(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$ is anchored and cannot match any business table, the parent events/events_archive tables, or the four fixed tables (events_default, events_archive_default, two *_pre_partition_20260922), which stay compared in both directions. Dimensions 2-13 are unchanged and still use unfiltered tables_in/1 intersections, so columns/constraints/indexes/triggers etc. of any dynamic partition present on both sides remain checked; RLS/owner/privilege checks are untouched. Residual: a dynamic partition present on only one side is no longer flagged by dimension 1; its name is date-dependent by nature and the clone side already excluded them from missing, so negligible coverage loss. INV-1 NOT-APPLICABLE (no tenant data access/scoping change; clone-vs-template parity checks preserved); INV-2/3/5/9 N/A; INV-4 N/A (no secrets; grep of diff clean); INV-6 satisfied by this review; INV-7 N/A (no new Repo.query, diff clean); INV-8 N/A (test code).
